endangerment.comment: Ugandan Sign Language (ugn-ugn) = 5 (Developing). Recognized language (1995, Constitution, Article XXIV(d)).

classification.sub: Although BSL was the first sign language used in deaf schools that lead up to the present Ugandan Sign language, comments on language influence (**hh:ldsoc:Lutalo:Ugandan-Sign**:814-815, **hh:g:Lutalo:Ugandan-Sign**:30-33, **hh:h:Kamei:Afurika-Shuwa**:48, **hh:h:LuleWallin:Sign-Africa**:121-122, **hh:d:Wallin:Uganda-Sign-Language**:16) appear to downplay this part which leaves ASL as the most probable main progenitor. A systematic lexical investigation remains to be done.
